description: The dock starts on the default bottom edge and moves to the right during capture, changing from a horizontal to a vertical item flow.

assertions.comment: Before I move the dock, the default bottom dock uses a 1024x108 horizontal window.
Before I move the dock, I see the bottom panel centered at x=402 in its horizontal window.
Before I move the dock, I see the bottom panel at y=36.
Before I move the dock, I see a 220px-wide horizontal panel.
Before I move the dock, I see a 64px-high horizontal panel.
Before I move the dock, I see its items flow from left to right.
After I move the dock to the right, its window swaps axes to 108x768.
After I move the dock to the right, I see the panel at x=36 in the 108px-wide dock window, leaving the 8px right margin.
After I move the dock to the right, I see the 220px panel centered at y=274 in the 768px-high dock window.
After I move the dock to the right, I see a 64px-wide vertical panel.
After I move the dock to the right, I see a 220px-high vertical panel.
After I move the dock to the right, I see its items flow from top to bottom.
